Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ and all.

I have some questions as to whether Mask of 1K Faces and Hidden Lurker can
be used effectively against Thoughts Betrayed. Specifically:

Suppose I bleed with Tusk, and Lizette Visquel blocks. Before combat is
entered, Lizette playes TB, intending to make mincemeat out of Tusk with a
Potence/Pulled Fanges combo in the ensueing combat. However, after combat
is entered and before range is chosen, Lucretia plays Mask of 1K Faces to
take over the combat (she can do this, right?), and Lizette finds to her
surprise that it is not really Tusk after all. Question is, can Lucretia
now play cards? TB card text states that "Opposing minion cannot use any
cards until after combat", so do the words "opposing minion" in this case
apply to any opposing minion in that combat, or merely to whoever was the
opposing minion at the time the card was played (Tusk in this case)?

Second question. Suppose that Lizette survives the combat with Lucretia.
As soon as the combat ends, Tusk playes Hidden Lurker to enter combat with
Lizette a second time. According to errata, Hidden Lurker is an action
modifier. Since there is no opportunity to block, then arguably combat is
entered the instant the card is played. Question is, does Lizette get an
opportunity to play another TB card from her hand, or is it already too
late?

Thanks in advance

John W.

Messages.Author: Quicksilver
Messages.Body:
John Whelan wrote:
>
>
>
> Hello LSJ and all.
>
> I have some questions as to whether Mask of 1K Faces and Hidden Lurker can

> be used effectively against Thoughts Betrayed. <snip>

>
> Thanks in advance
>
> John W.
>

Your questions were misguided because TB is played at the start of
combat and
is a combat card. It is not played outside of combat as a Action
Modifier.
Thus M1000F could not be played after TB.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
John Whelan <jbwh...@amanda.dorsai.org> wrote:
> I have some questions as to whether Mask of 1K Faces and Hidden Lurker can

> be used effectively against Thoughts Betrayed. Specifically:
>
> Suppose I bleed with Tusk, and Lizette Visquel blocks. Before combat is
> entered, Lizette playes TB, intending to make mincemeat out of Tusk with a
> Potence/Pulled Fanges combo in the ensueing combat. However, after combat
> is entered and before range is chosen, Lucretia plays Mask of 1K Faces to
> take over the combat (she can do this, right?),

No. Mask is an action modifier, and is played before combat (or earlier).
TB is a combat card that is played "as combat is entered."

> and Lizette finds to her
> surprise that it is not really Tusk after all. Question is, can Lucretia
> now play cards? TB card text states that "Opposing minion cannot use any
> cards until after combat", so do the words "opposing minion" in this case
> apply to any opposing minion in that combat, or merely to whoever was the
> opposing minion at the time the card was played (Tusk in this case)?

Moot. But, as a thought experiment: TB would continue to apply to
Lucretia. She is the "opposing minion" and TB is a continuing effect.

> Second question. Suppose that Lizette survives the combat with Lucretia.
> As soon as the combat ends, Tusk playes Hidden Lurker to enter combat with
> Lizette a second time. According to errata, Hidden Lurker is an action
> modifier. Since there is no opportunity to block, then arguably combat is
> entered the instant the card is played. Question is, does Lizette get an
> opportunity to play another TB card from her hand, or is it already too
> late?

She can play another TB, since TB is played as combat is entered (errata).
